product_one_liner.value: Paddle is a merchant-of-record platform that manages global payments, subscriptions, billing, tax and compliance for SaaS, AI, app and other digital-product businesses.

eng_blog.notes: Michael Woodward, Senior Software Engineer, explains webhook infrastructure; Kieran Mountford, Head of Engineering, explains the API-first rebuild of Paddle Billing.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live Senior AI Engineer (GTM) posting describes building AI systems and agentic workflows.

model_provider.notes: A public snapshot of Paddle’s subprocessor list names “AI Node (Gemini 2.5 model)” for onboarding/risk processing within Taktile workflows. The original Trust Center listing could not be read directly; this is not evidence that every Paddle product uses Gemini.

compliance_certs.notes: Paddle claims a completed SOC 2 Type 2 audit, GDPR compliance and PCI DSS SAQ A compliance; GDPR is a regulatory compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced July 17, 2025; this is growth financing from CIBC Innovation Banking, not a new equity-series round.

raised_18mo.notes: The $25 million financing announced July 17, 2025 falls within 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Senior Account Executive posting, San Francisco (remote).

launched_6mo.notes: Paddle announced its AI Toolkit on October 20, 2026, within 2026-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Diarmuid Considine joined as VP of Risk in September 2026; his October 21, 2026 announcement confirms the appointment.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Paddle’s public subprocessor-list snapshot identifies Salesforce and HubSpot as CRM systems, Gong as revenue intelligence/sales conversation analytics, and Mobly as event lead capture and GTM automation. These are use disclosures, not merely customer-facing integrations; the original Trust Center listing could not be read directly.
